Workflows.title: Search and Download Photos
Workflows.goal: Verify users can reach search results for specific keywords.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com
2. Type 'mountains' into the main search bar and press Enter
3. Click the 'Orientation' filter dropdown and select 'Landscape'
4. Click on the first image result to open the expanded view
5. Click the 'Download free' button in the top right corner
agent_activity_summary: The agent attempted to execute the image search and download workflow on Unsplash. After initial navigation, the agent encountered a site block or access issue. It attempted to recover by clicking the 'Go home' link and subsequently bypassing the home page by navigating directly to the search results URL for 'mountains'. However, upon reaching the search results, the agent identified a persistent 'hard blocker' and terminated the task without applying filters, selecting an image, or initiating a download.
agent_activity_error: At Step 2, the agent encountered a block on the Unsplash home page. Recovery was attempted in Steps 3 and 4 by clicking the 'Go home' link, and in Step 5 by navigating directly to the search results URL (https://unsplash.com/s/photos/mountains). While the agent successfully reached the search results page, it was unable to proceed with the UI interactions required for filtering and downloading, leading to a manual termination in Step 6.
agent_activity_outcome: The goal was not achieved. The agent failed to apply the 'Landscape' orientation filter, select an image, or trigger the 'Download free' action.
Workflows.agent_recommendation: Investigate the 'hard blocker' encountered, which likely indicates bot detection or a CAPTCHA. Recommend using a browser with stealth configurations or checking for UI overlays that prevent interaction with the search results and filter dropdowns.
test_steps: Navigate to homepage: Load the Unsplash homepage.
Direct Search Navigation: Navigate directly to the search results for 'mountains'.

Workflows.title: Unsplash+ Subscription Discovery
Workflows.goal: Verify users can access the Unsplash+ subscription page to view benefits.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com
2. Click the 'Unsplash+' link in the top navigation bar
3. Verify the 'Get Unsplash+' call-to-action and premium feature list are visible
agent_activity_summary: The agent attempted to navigate to Unsplash.com to access the Unsplash+ landing page but encountered a persistent access block. To recover, the agent tried clicking a 'Go home' link, navigating directly to the '/plus' subpage, and searching for the site via DuckDuckGo and Google to find an alternative entry point. Despite these varied recovery attempts, the site remained inaccessible, and the agent terminated the session after confirming a hard blocker was in place.
agent_activity_error: A persistent access block (likely bot detection or a firewall) was encountered at Step 1. The agent attempted several recovery strategies: Step 3 involved clicking a 'Go home' link; Step 4 attempted direct navigation to the target subpage (/plus); Steps 5 and 6 attempted to use external search engines as referral sources. None of these actions bypassed the block, leading to a terminal failure at Step 8.
agent_activity_outcome: The goal was not achieved. The agent was unable to view the Unsplash+ landing page or verify premium features due to a site-wide access restriction.
Workflows.agent_recommendation: Investigate the environment's IP reputation and bot detection headers. Consider using residential proxies or adjusting the automation framework to better mimic human behavior to bypass the 'hard blocker' identified during execution.
test_steps: Navigate to homepage: Navigate to the Unsplash homepage.
Navigate to Unsplash+ subpage: Directly navigate to the Unsplash+ landing page.
Navigate to Google: Navigate to Google to attempt an external referral entry point.
Navigate back to Unsplash: Return to Unsplash to confirm if the block persists.
Verify Block Page State: Identify the 'Go home' link on the blocked/error page.

Workflows.title: Help Center: Keyword Search and Article Discovery
Workflows.goal: Search for licensing information and read a relevant article. Success: Article content is displayed.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://help.unsplash.com/en/
2. Type 'commercial use' into the 'Search for articles...' input field
3. Press Enter to view results
4. Click the article 'Can I use Unsplash images for personal or commercial projects?'
5. Verify the full article text loads

Workflows.title: Developer Portal: API Documentation Exploration
Workflows.goal: Navigate technical documentation for image integration. Success: Hotlinking requirements are visible.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/developers
2. Click 'View the documentation'
3. Click 'Guidelines & Crediting' in the left sidebar
4. Click 'Hotlinking' to view the technical requirements and CDN usage rules

Workflows.title: Access Unsplash Datasets (Lite and Full)
Workflows.goal: Navigate to the data portal and access dataset download links. Success: Redirected to GitHub or Typeform.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/data
2. To access the Lite version: Click 'Download' under the Lite dataset section to redirect to GitHub
3. To access the Full version: Click 'Request access' under the Full dataset section to open the Typeform application

Workflows.title: Blog: Category Filtering and Content Loading
Workflows.goal: Filter blog posts by category and load more content. Success: New posts are appended to the list.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/blog/
2. Click the 'Product' category link in the navigation
3. Scroll to the bottom of the page and click the 'Load more posts' button
4. Click on the title of a newly loaded article to read it

Workflows.title: Developer Registration Flow
Workflows.goal: Initiate the process to register as a developer. Success: Reach the registration form.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/developers
2. Click the 'Register as a developer' button
3. Note: This flow may be blocked by bot detection (Access Denied) in automated environments
